summary: Iteration 7 audit log tests: 18/18 PASS (test_iter7_audit_log.py). Regression iter5+iter6 still 30/30 PASS. Total 48/48 backend tests pass. Verified: GET /api/activity-logs admin-only (401/403/200), login audit entry (success only, failed login NOT logged), purchase/production/sale/opex create+delete/change-password instrumentation with correct entity_id, summary tokens (PO/supplier/material/money, channel/sku/quantity/revenue, batch/HPP, 'dihapus'), and details payloads (sku, output_qty, hpp, linked_lines, channel, quantity, revenue). Filters action=create, entity=opex, user_email work. Pagination limit=5 offset=0 vs offset=5 return disjoint sets, rows sorted created_at DESC.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 492 lines - approaching the 700-line threshold; consider splitting into routers (auth, purchases, production, sales, opex, reports, activity_logs) before next iteration.

log_activity writes are best-effort but not wrapped in try/except. If Mongo insert fails, the API call itself will 500 AFTER the business op already committed. Consider wrapping in try/except and logging silently to preserve endpoint SLA.
activity_logs collection has no index on created_at/action/entity/user_email - the sort+filter query will full-scan as the collection grows. Add composite index in seed_data().
change_password does not invalidate the existing JWT/cookie; changed password still lets old token access until 8h expiry. Consider rotating token or blacklisting.
Failed login not being audited is a deliberate choice per spec, but from a security standpoint failed logins are exactly what an auditor wants to see - flag for product decision.
seed_data_creation: Tests create TEST_ prefixed purchase/production/sale/opex entries; opex is deleted at end. Purchase, production, sale rows persist (no delete endpoints).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Audit log endpoint /api/activity-logs is admin-only, supports filters action/entity/user_email and limit/offset pagination. activity_logs collection is append-only and grows every test run; always filter by entity_id or user_email markers rather than asserting total counts. All 48 backend tests across iter5/6/7 currently pass on preview URL.
